paragraphs.text: Grand Marshal Macie is a human performer and parade master for Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Originally serving beverages from the concession stand, Macie would leave her post to lead the parade whenever it came by. Myra kept swapping Macie's job around, but nothing changed until Myra gave in and let Macie lead the parades.
Macie is a natural-born leader, and those around her literally want to follow her. She has innate magic that makes the parade last longer.
